flavor.phonemic_palette: celtic (Insular / Goidelic register: ri/ruiri/ard-ri, tuath, dun/rath forts, Mac-/O- patronymics, initial consonant mutation, broad-slender consonants, root-initial stress - the horse-clans of the saddle and the cattle-raid) / near_eastern (old_persian / axsatran: the -pura cities and dida-citadels, the satrapal Xshacapavan/Marzapana office-register, the paridaida garden-courts, the poet-king populace, vowel-rich Indo-Iranian phonology flowing into poetic meter, the genitive '-ahya')

religion_hooks.alignment_lens: Resolved per the culture's chosen alignment (setting-lore): Lawful venerates the Lawful powers and names the Chaotic as demons; Chaotic the reverse; Neutral honors ancestral and local powers, invoking the great powers situationally.

flavor_text.one_line: Firarya — domineering martial aristocracy of the synthesis; conquest, honor, valor.
flavor_text.one_paragraph: The Firarya are a vigorous martial aristocracy people, a first-order synthesis of Albawyn and Aryastan [Conquest Aristocracy (albawyn over aryastan)]. They prize conquest, honor, valor, lean toward the military sphere, and field light_infantry, chariots, berserkers. Outsiders are met as domineering; their patrons touch war.
